value.rationale: The coordination number is a natural physical parameter for locally tree-like cooperative adsorption. The theorem completely determines species one-point kinetic densities at arbitrary bias, exposes a nontrivial conserved imbalance, and rigorously identifies two distinct large-coordination scales (balanced logarithmic-over-degree versus majority constant/minority inverse-degree). The exact logarithmic coefficient is non-obvious and useful for comparisons with finite-degree simulations; no general downstream theorem or finite-graph transfer is claimed.
